mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.input_tokens, u.output_tokens FROM afv_agent_model_call_usage u JOIN afv_agent_run a ON a.run_id = u.run_id JOIN afv_canvas_agent_node_job j ON j.node_run_id = JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.canvas_scope_json, '$.nodeRunId')) WHERE j.canvas_run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY u.id
SELECT j.input_json, s.model_snapshot_json FROM afv_generation_submission s JOIN afv_remote_generation_job j ON j.submission_id = s.id WHERE s.canvas_node_run_id = #{nodeRunId} AND s.kind = #{kind}

SELECT i.image_url FROM afv_generation_submission s JOIN afv_image_item i ON i.task_id = s.task_id WHERE s.canvas_node_run_id = #{nodeRunId} AND s.kind = 'IMAGE' AND i.status = 1 AND i.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY s.created_at, i.id

SELECT i.video_url FROM afv_generation_submission s JOIN afv_video_item i ON i.task_id = s.task_id WHERE s.canvas_node_run_id = #{nodeRunId} AND s.kind = 'VIDEO' AND i.status = 1 AND i.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY s.created_at, i.id
